welcome:
Hello, {{name}}! 👋 I'm your AI assistant 🤖

Tap /help to see what I can do.
help_body: 💬 AI Chat — just type any question and I'll answer. 🌐 Web search — include the word "search" or "internet" in your message. 🎬 Movie search — write "movie" followed by the title. Commands: /start — start the bot and choose language /help — show this help message /clean — clear your chat history /tarix — show your recent conversation history /muammo — send feedback or report a problem to the admin /premium — Premium plan info
